source: SPDX licence list (spdx.org/licenses) and the Open Definition conformant-licence list (opendefinition.org/licenses), plus the national open licences each portal uses (Etalab Licence Ouverte, UK/RO Open Government Licence, Germany Datenlizenz Deutschland). Not sourced from data.europa.eu.
note: Canonical licence families considered OPEN for Q25. licence_family() in licences.py maps a raw licence id/URI to one of these. Families absent here (e.g. cc-by-nc, cc-by-nd) carry usage restrictions and are not open under the Open Definition.
